limitations.incomplete_policy: No imputation; all comparison aggregates withheld until both groups complete
limitations.inference: Descriptive fixed-scene development comparison only; no independence-based confidence interval or untouched-test claim
limitations.statistical_unit: Five scene blocks; two policy seeds within a scene are correlated, not independent scenes
limitations.success_steps: Conditional on both methods succeeding; failures and aborts are censored, never assigned step 300
